name: Circle of Protection
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Uncheck a Condition. If you did, you create a protective circle out to short range, which moves with you as you move.

Whenever a creature within the circle is targeted by an attack, you may check a Condition to apply one of the following effects, once per attack:

  • Any rolls the creature is forced to make by the attack are favored.

  • The attack’s damage or Injury is reduced by 1d4+HEART.

  • The creature may reroll one engagement die for the attack.

If the Condition you unchecked was Troubled, you may apply a second effect per attack.

Describe the circle.

improvements.name: Greater Circle of Protection
improvements.description: The circle extends out to medium range.

improvements.name: Color Protection
improvements.description: When you cast this spell, choose a mana color. Spells of the chosen color cannot target creatures within the circle.
